transforms.operation: Resolve each attaching datasheet's English display name to its repository leader id while processing its bodyguard groups.
Convert the resolved datasheet display name into the repository entity id.

filters: Ignore Legends and Combat Patrol datasheets, unresolved names, and leaders absent from the faction unit file.
precedence: For the separate unit attachment_role side effect in runAttachmentRoles, support applies only when every group is support; any leader group wins so the flat role never over-constrains a solo-capable character.
A dump-derived leader-attachments record supersedes an existing record with the same leader_id; records for leaders absent from the dump are preserved.
/leader_id.reason: The bodyguard-group leader datasheet is converted to the repository leader id by the current attachment projection; bodyguardType also drives the documented leader-wins unit-role flattening.

transforms.operation: Traverse each leader group through its eligibility junction, resolve permitted bodyguard datasheet names, convert them to repository ids, deduplicate, and sort them.
Convert each resolved permitted-bodyguard display name into the repository entity id.

filters: Retain only bodyguards that resolve to unit ids in the current faction directory.
precedence: The junction is an eligibility relation, never ownership.
A dump-derived record supersedes the existing record for the same leader_id; when no bodyguard resolves, the existing record is preserved because the schema requires at least one id.
/eligible_bodyguard_ids.reason: The current projection emits explicit eligible bodyguard unit ids from datasheet_bodyguard_group_datasheet.

transforms.operation: Resolve, deduplicate, and sort each eligible bodyguard into a repository unit id.
Convert the permitted bodyguard datasheet display name into its repository entity id.

filters: Retain only ids present in the current faction unit file.
precedence: The eligibility junction does not establish unit ownership.
Sorted unique ids are emitted only when at least one bodyguard resolves.
/eligible_bodyguard_ids/*.reason: Each array item is a currently projected repository id for a permitted bodyguard datasheet.

/eligible_bodyguard_keywords.reason: Group-level keyword requirements plausibly correspond to keyword-based bodyguard eligibility, but attachment.ts currently emits only explicit bodyguard ids and does not establish how these requirement forms combine.

/eligible_bodyguard_keywords/*.reason: No current projection emits an individual keyword requirement as an eligible_bodyguard_keywords item.

transforms.operation: Attach the repository-confirmed game-version context to each emitted leader-attachment record.

/game_version.reason: The emitted game version is repository context, not inferred from an MFM bodyguard row.

transforms.operation: Copy the repository-confirmed dataslate context into emitted records.
Copy the repository-confirmed edition context into emitted records.

unmapped_mfm_fields.reason: This controls the separate unit attachment_role flattening in attachment.ts; leader-attachment.schema.json has no role destination. The projection uses leader-wins: all-support groups yield support, otherwise leader.
An excluded-detachment eligibility restriction has no destination in leader-attachment.schema.json and is not projected.
A required-detachment eligibility restriction has no destination in leader-attachment.schema.json and is not projected.
Plausible keyword-eligibility source, but current attachment projection does not emit it or establish its combination semantics.
Plausible group-keyword eligibility source, but current attachment projection does not emit it or establish its combination semantics.
